questions.question_text: The process of communication involves ________, encoding, channelizing, decoding and feedback.
questions.answer: Ideation (forming an idea) is the initial step before a message can be encoded.

questions.question_text: ________ is a type of speech delivered without any prior intimation and preparation.
questions.answer: Impromptu speaking means delivering a speech on the spot without preparation.

questions.question_text: Study about pitch and articulation in speech is called ________.
questions.answer: Paralinguistics studies vocal cues such as pitch, volume, and articulation.

questions.question_text: ________ is defined as "a groove or notch made by a cutting tool, such as a saw or an axe".
questions.answer: A kerf is the specific technical term for the width or groove of a cut.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text:
Choose the appropriate passive voice form of the following sentence:
They will demolish the entire block.
options: The entire block is being demolished by them
The entire block may be demolished by them
The entire block will have to be demolished by them
The entire block will be demolished by them
questions.answer: The simple future active verb 'will demolish' converts to the future passive form 'will be demolished'.

questions.question_text: The usage once in a blue moon is considered to be a ________.
questions.answer: The phrase is heavily overused, making it a cliché.

questions.question_text: Project proposal is a ________.
options: document that presents a plan of action
report written for a specific purpose
questions.answer: A proposal outlines a recommended course or plan of action for approval.

questions.question_text: Which of these punctuation mark is used between sentences that are grammatically independent?
questions.answer: A semicolon appropriately connects two closely related but independent clauses.

questions.question_text: Flowchart is a pictorial representation of --------.
questions.answer: Flowcharts visually map out the sequence of steps in a process.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text: A report is ________.
options: an official document written for a specific purpose and for a specific audience
questions.answer: Reports are structured documents targeted at specific audiences for clear objectives.

questions.question_text: When Carol called last night, I ________ my favourite show.
questions.answer: The past continuous tense is required for an action happening at the time of another event.

questions.question_text: We were late because we ________ some problems. By the time we reached home, Susan ________ for us for more than two hours.
questions.answer: 'Had' indicates an action before arriving, and 'had been waiting' describes the ongoing action up to that point.

questions.question_text: The verb form of 'etymology' is ________.
questions.answer: To etymologize means to study or describe the origin of a word.

questions.question_text: Words that have the same spelling but different meanings with different pronunciations are ________
questions.answer: Homographs share the same spelling but have different meanings and sometimes distinct pronunciations.

questions.question_text:
Choose the correct homonym:
The plane's ----- made my ears pop.
questions.answer: Ascent refers to the act of climbing or moving upward.

questions.question_text: Feasibility report studies the ________ of carrying out a project.
questions.answer: A feasibility report assesses whether a proposed project is practical or viable.

questions.question_text: "Use the freedom judiciously". This is ---------.
questions.answer: The imperative verb 'Use' forms a direct instruction.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text:
Choose the correct parallel structure:
Joe likes ________
questions.answer: Using the '-ing' gerund form consistently for all items maintains grammatical parallelism.

questions.question_text:
Choose the appropriate word to complete the analogy that is closest to the one given:
BEES: HIVE
questions.answer: A hive is the natural home of bees, just as a den is the natural home of bears.

questions.question_text:
Convert the following direct speech into indirect speech:
She said, "My mother is cooking food"
options: She said that her mother was cooking food
She said that her mother is cooking food
She said that my mother was cooking food
She said that my mother is cooking food
questions.answer: The pronoun 'my' changes to 'her', and present continuous changes to past continuous in reported speech.

questions.question_text: The zipper differs from the other three fastening devices mentioned in paragraph 1 in which way?
options: it has been used in many more ways
it can be used in place of the other three
it is usually made from different materials
questions.answer: The other devices have existed for thousands of years, while the zipper is a more recent invention.

questions.question_text: The word "prototype" in line 8 is closest in meaning to
questions.answer: A prototype is an early model built to test a concept.

questions.question_text: What is the author's main point in the second paragraph?
options: despite being a successful inventor, Judson failed with the clasp-locker
Although Judson invented a workable product, it did not appeal to the public
questions.answer: The passage notes that despite having a working prototype, the public largely ignored it.

questions.question_text: The word "it" in line 11 refers to
questions.answer: The sentence says the public largely ignored 'it', referring directly to Judson's invention, the clasp-locker.

questions.question_text: The word "refinements" in line 12 is closest in meaning to
questions.answer: Refinements involve making slight changes to improve a product.

questions.question_text: According to the passage, zippers did not really become a success until
options: they were used in the apparel industry after 1905
the Army used them in World War I
questions.answer: The text explicitly states it was only in 1913, after Gideon Sundbach remodeled it, that the zipper was a success.

questions.question_text: The word "gear" in line 16 is closest in meaning to
questions.answer: In this military context, 'gear' signifies the equipment carried by troops.

questions.question_text: The word "embraced" in line 18 is closest in meaning to
questions.answer: To embrace a new idea or product means to welcome and adopt it enthusiastically.

questions.question_text: According to the passage, the zipper got its name
questions.answer: The term was coined as onomatopoeia, meaning it was named after the sound it makes.

questions.question_text: Which of the following descriptions best describes the author's last comments about Judson?
questions.answer: The author notes 'Regrettably' that Judson died before seeing his invention's massive success, setting a sad or lamenting tone.
